guidebook.span_sentence: The study evaluated the impact of passive smoking on respiratory health outcomes in school-aged children.

triad.description: Generator erroneously overrode BERT's correct prediction of Substance_use for secondhand tobacco smoke exposure, misclassifying it as Environmental_exposures.

guidebook.guideline: When BERT predicts Substance_use on tobacco smoke exposure terms (e.g., passive smoking, secondhand smoke, environmental tobacco smoke), confirm BERT and preserve Substance_use; do not override BERT to Environmental_exposures, as all forms of tobacco consumption and direct smoke exposure fall within the substance use domain.

guidebook.span_sentence: Assessment of passive smoking and health outcomes.

triad.description: BERT misclassified passive tobacco smoke exposure as Environmental_exposures, and Generator uncritically adopted it instead of resolving to canonical Substance_use.

guidebook.guideline: When BERT predicts Environmental_exposures on tobacco smoke exposure mentions (e.g., passive smoking, secondhand smoke, environmental tobacco smoke), override BERT and label as Substance_use because all active and passive tobacco-related exposures fall under substance use rather than general environmental hazards; preserve Environmental_exposures for non-tobacco ambient pollutants (e.g., particulate matter, ambient ozone).

triad.description: Generator erroneously overrode BERT's accurate Nutrition prediction for a dietary mineral, misclassifying it as an excluded endogenous biomarker.

guidebook.guideline: When BERT predicts Nutrition on essential dietary minerals or micronutrients (e.g., potassium, sodium, calcium, magnesium), confirm BERT and preserve Nutrition; do not override BERT to O under biomarker exclusion unless the context unambiguously denotes an involuntary systemic assay or clinical diagnostic pathology rather than dietary intake or nutritional supplementation.

triad.description: Generator erroneously overrode BERT's correct prediction of Substance_use for a targeted smoking cessation pharmacotherapy phrase, misclassifying it as Non-LSF under general medication exclusions.

guidebook.guideline: When BERT predicts Substance_use on pharmacotherapies or cessation interventions explicitly contextualized for substance cessation (e.g., medications for smoking cessation, nicotine replacement therapy, cessation patches), confirm BERT and preserve Substance_use; override to O only when a therapy or medication is prescribed for general psychiatric or medical indications lacking explicit substance cessation context.

triad.description: Generator uncritically accepted BERT's false-positive Nutrition prediction for a nutrient term appearing in a non-behavioral, non-dietary context.

guidebook.guideline: When BERT predicts Nutrition on nutrient or micronutrient terms (e.g., folic acid, vitamin D, iron), override BERT and label as O when the mention occurs in an isolated chemical, assay, biochemical pathway, or non-behavioral context; preserve Nutrition when the span refers to active dietary intake, voluntary supplementation, or nutritional consumption habits.
